result.quote: the two divisions that would go off duty on the Sabbath are to guard the house of the LORD for the king.
result.reason: Verse 11:7 uniquely supports the key; “Yahweh’s house” co-refers to “the house of the LORD.” However, “groups not serving” is misleading because they are assigned to guard the house. “What are the two divisions that would go off duty on the Sabbath to do?” would state the situation accurately.
